title: Diagnostic Cleft Clauses in Socio-Political Analysis

sections.title: Diagnosing Systemic Causes with Cleft Predicates
sections.content: You know *nem más, mint* from B2 Unit 65; *éppen abban áll, hogy* follows the pattern of a demonstrative plus a *hogy* clause from B2 Unit 17 (*függetlenül attól, hogy*). Political essays often deploy diagnostic cleft predicates to lay bare the psychological or institutional root of collective failures. By structuring the sentence around 'A baj lényege éppen abban áll, hogy...' (The essence of the trouble consists precisely in that...) or 'A kudarc oka nem más, mint...' (The cause of failure is none other than...), the author sharply focuses on the critical variable.

sections.title: Moral and Existential Definitions in High-Register Prose
sections.content: Definitional clefts state what a concept is: 'Demokratának lenni nem más, mint nem félni' (To be a democrat is none other than not being afraid). This is an illustrative sentence in the style of political essays, not a quotation. Such formulations set out ethical benchmarks against which political reality can be judged.

sections.title: Diagnostic Cleft Structures
rows: A hisztéria oka nem más, mint az egzisztenciális félelem.
The cause of hysteria is none other than existential fear.
A baj lényege éppen abban áll, hogy nem mernek szembenézni a tényekkel.
The essence of the trouble lies precisely in that they dare not face the facts.
A kiút éppen abban áll, hogy elismerjük a hibáinkat.
The way out lies precisely in that we admit our mistakes.

items.spanish: Bibó szerint a politikai hisztéria természete éppen abban áll, hogy a közösség a valóság elismerése helyett bűnbakokat keres.
items.english: According to Bibó, the nature of political hysteria consists precisely in that the community seeks scapegoats instead of acknowledging reality.

items.spanish: Bibó szerint a kelet-európai kisállamok nyomorúságának fő oka nem más, mint a folyamatos határbizonytalanság miatti rettegés.
items.english: According to Bibó, the main cause of the misery of small Eastern European states is none other than terror due to continuous border instability.

items.spanish: A demokratikus cselekvés ereje éppen abban rejlik, hogy a polgárok nem hagyják magukat megfélemlíteni.
items.english: The strength of democratic action lies precisely in that citizens do not allow themselves to be intimidated.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Use 'éppen abban áll / rejlik, hogy...' when dissecting psychological mechanisms or systemic paradoxes in historical analysis.
